corrections_applied.verdict: SALAH. gan_axi_wrapper.v ADA di rtl/ (226 baris). Modul ini menginstansiasi generator_top sebagai u_gen. Register Bank slv_reg0..8 dan AXI4-Lite slave logic ada di sini.
corrections_applied.action: TETAP di netlist, tapi ditandai bahwa ini bisa dianggap external wrapper tergantung scope analisis

corrections_applied.claim: valid_vec dari addr_gen masuk LANGSUNG ke mac_array
corrections_applied.verdict: BENAR. conv_unified.v line 343: .valid_vec(valid_vec_w) langsung ke u_mac_array. Tidak ada blok select terpisah.

corrections_applied.claim: adder_tree adalah INSTANCE DI DALAM mac_array
corrections_applied.verdict: BENAR. mac_array.v line 88: adder_tree u_adder_tree instantiated inside mac_array.

corrections_applied.claim: WEIGHT_CACHE cache SELURUH c_in untuk 1 c_out; ifmap di-refetch tiap c_in
corrections_applied.verdict: BENAR. conv_unified.v line 418-458: fill_c_in_cnt loops 0..cfg_c_in-1, fills ALL weight BRAM SEBELUM masuk FETCH_I. Weight cache hanya di-refill saat c_out berubah (line 626-628). Ifmap di-refetch setiap c_in (line 547: ST_FETCH_I_SETUP).
corrections_applied.action: DIPERBAIKI: detail weight cache dan ifmap tile description diperbarui

corrections_applied.claim: Ada feedback current_c_out (conv_unified) -> bias_mem yang hilang
corrections_applied.verdict: BENAR bahwa feedback ini ada. conv_unified.v line 101: assign current_c_out = c_out_cnt. generator_top.v line 105: wire signed [DW-1:0] current_bias = bias_mem[cfg_bias_base + current_c_out]. Netlist v1 SUDAH punya edge W13 untuk ini.

corrections_applied.claim: Write ke OUT_BUF hanya layer 11, read IMG_BUF hanya layer 0
corrections_applied.verdict: BENAR. generator_top.v line 91-99: cur_ifmap_base = (layer_idx==0) ? reg_img_base : ping_pong ? fmap_b : fmap_a. cur_ofmap_base = (layer_idx==11) ? reg_out_base : ping_pong ? fmap_a : fmap_b.

corrections_applied.claim: 3 aktivasi SELALU jalan, di-mux oleh cur_act
corrections_applied.verdict: BENAR. conv_unified.v line 378-386: valid_in=1'b1 untuk ketiga aktivasi. Line 388-391: final_pixel = mux by cur_act. cur_act=3 → acc_trunc langsung (no activation).
corrections_applied.action: Sudah benar di netlist v1, ditambah detail cur_act=3

corrections_applied.claim: Ada tahap requant terpisah: round+shift+saturate SEBELUM activation
corrections_applied.verdict: BENAR. conv_unified.v line 366: acc_rounded = acc_reg + (1<<(FRAC_W-1)). Line 367: acc_shifted = acc_rounded[ACC_W-1:FRAC_W]. Line 371-373: saturate. Output acc_trunc masuk ke semua activations.
corrections_applied.action: DIPERBAIKI: REQUANT_SAT dipecah jadi node terpisah dari ACCUMULATOR

corrections_applied.claim: batchnorm2d ADA di source tapi TIDAK diinstansiasi
corrections_applied.verdict: BENAR. batchnorm2d.v ada di rtl/ tapi tidak di-instantiate di module manapun. Orphan module. BN sudah di-fold ke weights saat training.

corrections_applied.claim: Nama sinyal diambil PERSIS dari RTL
corrections_applied.verdict: BENAR dan PENTING. Semua nama sinyal di netlist v2 diverifikasi vs RTL source.

levels.label: gan_axi_wrapper
levels.note: ADA di RTL (gan_axi_wrapper.v). Berisi AXI4-Lite slave + Register Bank. Instantiasi generator_top sebagai u_gen.

nodes.label: S_AXI_HP0
nodes.detail: High-Performance AXI4 Port for DDR access

nodes.label: AXI4-Lite Slave
nodes.detail: s_axi_* interface. 6-bit addr (4-bit decoded), 32-bit data. Handles AW/W/B/AR/R channels.

registers.name: slv_reg7
registers.function: bias_data ([15:0]:wr_data). Writing this reg pulses bias_wr_en.

nodes.label: Layer Sequencer FSM
nodes.detail: Main FSM: sequences through 12 NN layers (layer_idx 0..11). Contains task set_layer_info() that configures all layer parameters.

nodes.label: Bias LUT Memory
nodes.detail: bias_mem[0:4095] BRAM. Written by PS via wr_en (gated: wr_type==2'd3). Read address = cfg_bias_base + current_c_out. target_bias_base LUT maps wr_layer to base offset (e.g. layer0→0, layer1→32, ... layer11→2016).

nodes.label: Ping-Pong Address MUX
nodes.detail: Combinational mux. cur_ifmap_base: layer_idx==0 → reg_img_base, else ping_pong ? reg_fmap_b_base : reg_fmap_a_base. cur_ofmap_base: layer_idx==11 → reg_out_base, else ping_pong ? reg_fmap_a_base : reg_fmap_b_base. ping_pong toggles every layer in ST_NEXT_LAYER.

nodes.label: Layer Config LUT
nodes.detail: task set_layer_info(idx): case statement outputs cfg_c_in, cfg_c_out, cfg_h_in, cfg_w_in, cfg_h_out, cfg_w_out, cfg_k, cfg_stride, cfg_pad, cfg_mode, cfg_weight_base, cur_act, cfg_bias_base per layer_idx 0..11.

nodes.label: addr_gen (u_addr_gen)
nodes.detail: Purely combinational. For each of 16 taps (KxK, max 4x4=16): computes ifmap address (18-bit, CHW layout), weight address (26-bit), and validity flag. cfg_mode=0: Conv2D (in_y = h_out*stride - pad + dy). cfg_mode=1: ConvTranspose2D (in_y = h_out + pad - dy, with stride divisibility check).

nodes.label: Addr-Gen Pipeline Register
nodes.detail: Registers addr_gen outputs to break critical path: cfg_* → addr_gen (comb) → burst_calc → m_axi_arlen. Captured in ST_FILL_W_SETUP / ST_FETCH_I_SETUP states (1 cycle before AR states). _r suffix signals.

nodes.label: Burst Length + 4KB Clamp
nodes.detail: Combinational. Computes AXI burst parameters: byte-aligned start address, number of beats (ceil((offset+count)/2)), and clamps burst length to avoid crossing 4KB AXI page boundary. Two versions: combinational (_w, used in _R states) and registered (_r, used in _AR states).

nodes.label: AXI4 Master FSM + Datapath Control
nodes.detail: 12-state FSM driving all AXI4 master signals and internal data movement. Controls weight fill, ifmap fetch, MAC issue, accumulation, and writeback. Manages counters: c_out_cnt, c_in_cnt, fill_c_in_cnt, h_cnt, w_cnt, wc, fr, beat_cnt, ph.

nodes.label: Weight Cache (16x BRAM)
nodes.detail: 16 independent BRAMs: weight_cache_0..15, each [0:511] x 16-bit. Caches ALL c_in channels for ONE c_out channel (prefetch loop: fill_c_in_cnt 0..cfg_c_in-1 BEFORE any compute). Only re-filled when c_out_cnt changes (line 626-628). Read side: weight_tile[0:15] registered output indexed by c_in_cnt.
nodes.write_timing: ST_FILL_W_R: demuxed by w_pos[3:0], indexed by fill_c_in_cnt

nodes.label: ifmap Tile Registers
nodes.detail: ifmap_tile[0:15], 16x INT16 registers. Holds ONE KxK input patch for the current (c_out, h_out, w_out, c_in) position. NOT cached across c_in channels — re-fetched from DDR every c_in iteration via per-kernel-row AXI burst. Slot assignment depends on cfg_mode (conv2d vs transpose).
nodes.read_timing: Flattened to ifmap_vec via generate loop

nodes.label: Vector Flatten (generate loop)
nodes.detail: generate for loop: packs weight_tile[0:15] → weight_vec[255:0] and ifmap_tile[0:15] → ifmap_vec[255:0] as flat bit vectors for mac_array input.

nodes.label: mac_array (u_mac_array)
nodes.detail: K*K=16 parallel MAC units with 2-stage pipeline (PIPE_STAGES=2). Latency: 2 cycles from in_valid to out_valid. Contains MUL_ARRAY → PIPELINE_REGS → ADDER_TREE. Valid shift register delays in_valid by 2 cycles for out_valid.

nodes.label: 16x Signed Multipliers
nodes.detail: Stage 0 (combinational): For each of 16 taps: ival = valid_vec[m] ? ifmap_vec[m] : 0 (zero-force invalid taps). prod[m] = wval_32 * ival_32 (16b cast to 32b BEFORE multiply to avoid truncation). prod_sx[m] = sign-extend prod[m] to 48b.

nodes.label: Pipeline Registers (Stage 1)
nodes.detail: prod_reg[0:15] (48-bit each). Registered at posedge clk. Breaks DSP multiply → adder-tree critical path.

nodes.label: Binary Adder Tree (u_adder_tree)
nodes.detail: Recursive binary adder tree module (adder_tree). Reduces 16 products → 1 sum. Levels: 16→8→4→2→1, 48-bit width. Output registered as sum_out_reg (Stage 2).

nodes.label: Accumulator + Bias Add
nodes.detail: acc_reg (48-bit signed). Latched from acc_next when mac_out_valid asserts (ST_COMPUTE_WAIT). Formula: acc_next = is_first ? (bias_extended + row_sum) : (acc_reg + row_sum). is_first = (c_in_cnt == 0). bias_extended = sign_extend(bias_val) <<< FRAC_W. Accumulates across all c_in channels per output pixel.

key_signals.all_done: is_last && last pixel of last channel

nodes.label: Requantize + Saturate
nodes.detail: Three-step fixed-point conversion (all combinational, driven by acc_reg): (1) Round: acc_rounded = acc_reg + (1 << (FRAC_W-1)) = +0.5 ULP. (2) Shift: acc_shifted = acc_rounded[47:8] (>>FRAC_W, arithmetic). (3) Saturate: acc_trunc = clamp(acc_shifted, -32768, 32767) → INT16. NOTE: Uses acc_reg NOT acc_next to avoid double-counting last c_in contribution.

key_signals.acc_trunc: 16-bit, saturated INT16 output → feeds all activations

nodes.label: leaky_relu (u_lrelu)
nodes.detail: Combinational. y = (x >= 0) ? x : (x * 51) >>> FRAC_W. Slope = 51/256 ≈ 0.199. Always active (valid_in=1'b1). Selected when cur_act=0 (layers 0-4: encoder).

nodes.label: relu (u_relu)
nodes.detail: Combinational. y = (x >= 0) ? x : 0. Always active (valid_in=1'b1). Selected when cur_act=1 (layers 6-10: decoder).

nodes.label: tanh_act (u_tanh)
nodes.detail: Combinational (clk port unused). 33-entry LUT (tanh(k*0.125)*256 for k=0..32) + linear interpolation between entries. Odd-function symmetry: compute |x|, look up, apply sign. Saturates to ±1.0 (±256 in Q8.8) for |x| >= 4.0. Always active (valid_in=1'b1). Selected when cur_act=2 (layer 11: output).

nodes.label: Activation MUX
nodes.detail: final_pixel = (cur_act==0) ? lrelu_out : (cur_act==1) ? relu_out : (cur_act==2) ? tanh_out_w : acc_trunc. Note cur_act=3 → acc_trunc passed through directly (no activation, used for bottleneck layer 5: 1x1 conv).

nodes.label: Output Address Calculator
nodes.detail: Combinational. ofmap_word_offset = c_out_cnt * (h_out * w_out) + h_cnt * w_out + w_cnt. ofmap_byte_addr = cfg_ofmap_base + (ofmap_word_offset << 1). Drives m_axi_awaddr. Byte parity (bit[1]) selects upper/lower half of 32-bit AXI word → wstrb = 0011 or 1100.

nodes.label: batchnorm2d [ORPHAN - NOT INSTANTIATED]
nodes.detail: EXISTS in RTL source but is NEVER instantiated by any module. BN parameters are folded into conv weights and biases at training/export time. Has its own write interface (wr_en/wr_sel/wr_addr/wr_data) different from the bias write path.

edges.label: AXI4-Lite
signals: handshake: awvalid/awready, wvalid/wready, bvalid/bready, arvalid/arready, rvalid/rready

edges.label: AXI4 Master (DDR R/W)
edges.note: m_axi_* signals pass through generator_top and gan_axi_wrapper as wire passthrough. Sideband: arcache=awcache=0011 (Normal Non-cacheable Bufferable), prot=000, qos=0000.

edges.label: start_pulse
signals: start_pulse (1b, single-cycle pulse when slv_reg0[0] written as 1)

edges.label: ifmap/ofmap base addrs
edges.note: Layer 0: ifmap=IMG_BUF. Layer 11: ofmap=OUT_BUF. Others: ping-pong fmap_a/fmap_b.

edges.label: layer_idx + ping_pong
edges.note: Drives the ifmap/ofmap address mux selection

edges.label: bias_val[15:0]
edges.note: current_bias = bias_mem[cfg_bias_base + current_c_out]. Crosses from generator_top into conv_unified.

edges.label: current_c_out[11:0]
edges.note: FEEDBACK: conv_unified outputs current_c_out (= c_out_cnt) so generator_top can compute bias read address.

edges.label: Position counters
signals: effective_c_in[11:0] (fill_c_in_cnt or c_in_cnt depending on state)

edges.label: Addresses (reg _r)
edges.note: Used in _AR states for short timing path

edges.label: Weight fill (AXI read)
edges.note: ST_FILL_W_R: fills ALL c_in for current c_out before any compute

edges.label: Ifmap fetch (AXI read)
edges.note: ST_FETCH_I_R: re-fetched every c_in iteration, per kernel row burst

edges.label: valid_vec_w[15:0]
edges.note: DIRECT connection from addr_gen to mac_array. Combinational _w version. Zero-forces invalid taps inside MUL_ARRAY.

edges.label: acc_reg[47:0]
edges.note: Combinational path: acc_reg → round → shift → saturate

edges.label: acc_trunc[15:0] (bypass)
edges.note: Direct path for cur_act=3 (no activation, bottleneck)

edges.label: ofmap_byte_addr[31:0]
edges.note: Drives m_axi_awaddr (force 4-byte aligned). wstrb selected by addr[1].

edges.label: all_done → done
edges.note: all_done = is_last && last pixel of last channel → done pulse → feeds W11

rules: Layer 0 (E1):  ifmap = IMG_BUF (0x0400_0000), ofmap = fmap_b → ping_pong starts 0
Layer 1 (E2):  ifmap = fmap_b, ofmap = fmap_a → ping_pong = 1
Layer 2 (E3):  ifmap = fmap_a, ofmap = fmap_b → ping_pong = 0
Layer 3 (E4):  ifmap = fmap_b, ofmap = fmap_a → ping_pong = 1
Layer 4 (E5):  ifmap = fmap_a, ofmap = fmap_b → ping_pong = 0
Layer 5 (BOT): ifmap = fmap_b, ofmap = fmap_a → ping_pong = 1
Layer 6 (D1):  ifmap = fmap_a, ofmap = fmap_b → ping_pong = 0
Layer 7 (D2):  ifmap = fmap_b, ofmap = fmap_a → ping_pong = 1
Layer 8 (D3):  ifmap = fmap_a, ofmap = fmap_b → ping_pong = 0
Layer 9 (D4):  ifmap = fmap_b, ofmap = fmap_a → ping_pong = 1
Layer 10 (D5): ifmap = fmap_a, ofmap = fmap_b → ping_pong = 0
Layer 11 (OUT): ifmap = fmap_b, ofmap = OUT_BUF (0x0700_0000) → ping_pong = 1
ping_pong_detail.rtl_logic: cur_ifmap = (layer_idx==0) ? img_base : ping_pong ? fmap_b : fmap_a. cur_ofmap = (layer_idx==11) ? out_base : ping_pong ? fmap_a : fmap_b. ping_pong toggles in ST_NEXT_LAYER.
